pages.text: Stores mixed RGB paint and amount. Craft cans in the Paint Mixer, place them in the world, or carry them as items. The icon shows R, G, and B channel swatches in the corner when held.
Right-click a Paint Brush or load paint into machines from the can. Canvas, Glass Canvas, and stencils consume paint over time. Tooltip shows hex colour and remaining millilitres.
Mix dyes in the Paint Mixer to fill cans.
